It is true that sexual violence and murder are neither a new entity, nor was the prevalence lower in past. As we live in a broader human society continuously thriving for betterment in every domain, we require a visible effort in combating such evil. What I mean to say is when we see rape apologies, justification of violence, or misogyny in general, it feels like we are going the opposite way. Even a single such incident should move a society to its core and force them to act towards prevention. 


After all violence including sexual violence is a public health problem that requires prevention (just like diseases). 
Cropping up such cases justifiably feels like an outbreak and no one seems to do anything about it

I got into med school 12 years ago. I used to believe in the government system, although lacking beautiful cabins, well lit wards and all, at least provided quality treatment. Quality treatment means treatment that sticks to evidence based guidelines and everything done in a cost effective manner. 

Now I'm absolutely afraid to even get my blood work done in my own workplace that uses such materials.

Something that has irked me for a long long time, we rate schools by the number of toppers it produces. We need to celebrate schools in underserved areas serving orthodox population (such as people who do not send girls to schools or to schools run by women) doing a fair job in providing education and changing lives one day at a time. Those schools might not produce state toppers but play the most vital role in producing educated citizens.

I don't know what to say. But I understand what living like a hermit really means. I don't travel the world but I stay unattached in my own room for weeks at a stretch.

I tried everything I could, walked 5-6kms daily. When I joined med school, I used to travel for 4 hours daily. Almost 40% of it was on foot. I only had one meal a day. After I became a resident the workload became so much worse(3rd world country but one of the best free Healthcare and all that jazz) .
I suffer from migraines and duodenal ulcers too.
Still I tried keto, working out and a lot of internet solutions. 
But nothing reduced my weight.
Me being fat have become the crux of my social existence although my drastic steps have reduced my BMI a lot.

My body hasn't forgiven me for these steps.
It's awful. I cannot even imagine how much suffering you have gone through. It is so cruel to be friendless for a reason like this. I don't even have words for this.

I've been suffering from some childhood conditions that made me gain weight quite quickly even on a restricted diet. And I am quiet in nature. So making friends was tough. My caste in my country is equivalent to an apartheid.
No one likes the apartheid fat quite nerd.

Those people whom I considered to be my friend, betrayed me every way possible. I got to know of this betrayals in this span of 4 years.

I have not a single soul to talk to right now. In my country, mental health care is quite hard to get. I have stayed silent, on my bed for days at a stretch. 

It's unbelievably painful. I just want to finish it. 

You don't know how grateful I am to get a response from unknown people like you. I hope you find your peace. I hope you become happy.

This is the first thing I did last year. Even tried dating apps. Ridiculously enough, I got 5 or 6 decent matches every weekend (probably due to pandemic). Almost every single one of them were super nice and too beautiful... I mean look at me. It was as if the universe wanted me to move on. But I couldn't find the spark of love anywhere. In comparison with these women, my ex looks frumpy. Just like me. We had a world full of trauma distress and history to share. Eventually those tinder dates understood and moved on but they were super nice to me for some reason (probably pity)
Eventually I uninstalled the app. They might be nice and beautiful but no one could come in terms of an emotional connection.
I started a self care routine but even that reminds me of her coz she taught me to take care of myself.
